shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json

cat index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50; for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules | head -80; ls /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.318/0eeb63b8e936b14dcac2c709b55e704f/dataviz/references
cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui node_modules/@hello-pangea; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '
cd /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.318/0eeb63b8e936b14dcac2c709b55e704f/dataviz/references && cat palette.md choosing-a-form.md | head -250

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat DropdownMenu/types.d.ts | head -60; grep -n "theme\|icon\|type" Label/Label.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "data\|size" Icon/Icon.d.ts | head; ls ../../../../icons 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -n '"@gravity-ui/icons"' ../../../../../../package-lock.json | head -3; git -C /home/sandbox/workspace log --oneline | head -2
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/src/widgets && sed -i 's/export const OrdersWidget = () => (/export const OrdersCountWidget = () => (/' StatWidgets.tsx && sed -i 's/export function OrdersWidget()/export function OrdersTableWidget()/' ListWidgets.tsx && grep -n "export" StatWidgets.tsx ListWidgets.tsx
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -8; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

rm -rf dist; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome playwright 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | head
mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && timeout 120 npm i playwright 2>&1 | tail -3 && timeout 240 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5
id -u; sudo -n true 2>&1 | head -1; which apt-get; (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null) | grep 5199; ps aux | grep -c "[v]ite"; cat /tmp/vite.log | head

B=/home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell; ldd $B 2>&1 | grep "not found"; ls /var/lib/apt/lists 2>/dev/null | head -3; curl -sI --max-time 5 http://deb.debian.org | head -1

mkdir -p /tmp/debs /tmp/libs && cd /tmp/debs && timeout 200 apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libatspi2.0-0 libx11-6 libxcb1 libxext6 libxau6 libxdmcp6 libpcre2-8-0 libffi8 libmount1 libblkid1 libselinux1 libwayland-server0 libdrm2 libexpat1 libsystemd0 libbsd0 libmd0 libxrender1 libxi6 libxtst6 libcups2 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 2>&1 | tail -4; ls | wc -l; for f in *.deb; do dpkg -x $f /tmp/libs; done; ls /tmp/libs/usr/lib/*/ | head -5

B=/home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(ls -d /tmp/libs/usr/lib/*-linux-gnu /tmp/libs/lib/*-linux-gnu 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ':'); echo $LD_LIBRARY_PATH; ldd $B 2>&1 | grep "not found"; echo ---; (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E "5199|5173") || echo "no ss"; node -e "require('net').connect(5199,'localhost').on('connect',()=>{console.log('5199 busy');process.exit()}).on('error',()=>{console.log('5199 free');process.exit()})"
node -e "fetch('http://localhost:5199/').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>console.log(t.slice(0,300)))"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && timeout 100 node check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -30

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && sed -i "s/await chromium.launch()/await chromium.launch({ args: ['--no-sandbox','--disable-gpu','--disable-dev-shm-usage'], env: process.env })/" check.mjs && timeout 110 node check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -30

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && DEBUG=pw:browser timeout 60 node crash.mjs 2>&1 | grep -E "ERR |title|FATAL|Check failed|Segmentation|signal|exitCode|Out of memory|crash" | head

cd /tmp/debs && timeout 100 apt-get download libfreebl3 libsqlite3-0 libnss3 2>&1 | tail -1; for f in libfreebl3*.deb libsqlite3*.deb; do dpkg -x $f /tmp/libs; done; find /tmp/libs -name "libsoftokn3*" -o -name "libfreebl3*" -o -name "libnssckbi*" | head; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/nss; cd /tmp/pw && timeout 60 node crash.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; ldd /tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libsoftokn3.so | grep "not found"; ldd /tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libfreebl3.so | grep "not found"; apt-cache policy libsqlite3-0 2>&1 | head -3; ls /usr/lib/*/libsqlite3* 2>&1 | head -2

cd /tmp/debs && timeout 60 apt-get download libsqlite3-0 2>&1 | tail -1; dpkg -x libsqlite3-0*.deb /tmp/libs; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && timeout 60 node crash.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && timeout 110 node check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /workspace 2>/dev/null; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git status --short; grep -rl "Обзор продукта" --include=*.tsx --include=*.ts --include=*.html . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head; grep -c "Обзор продаж" src/App.tsx; for pid in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $pid/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *vite*) echo "$(basename $pid): $c  cwd=$(readlink $pid/cwd)";; esac; done

(nohup npx vite --port 5287 --strictPort > /tmp/vite2.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3; cat /tmp/vite2.log | tail -4; node -e "fetch('http://localhost:5287/src/App.tsx').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>console.log('mine:', t.includes('Обзор продаж')))"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && sed -i 's/5199/5287/g' check.mjs && timeout 110 node check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -30
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && timeout 110 node check.mjs 2>&1 | head -12; ls shots

cd /tmp/debs && timeout 100 apt-get download fonts-dejavu-core fontconfig-config 2>&1 | tail -1; dpkg -x fonts-dejavu-core*.deb /tmp/libs; mkdir -p /tmp/fc && cat > /tmp/fc/fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd">
<fontconfig>
  <dir>/tmp/libs/usr/share/fonts</dir>
  <cachedir>/tmp/fc/cache</cachedir>
  <alias><family>sans-serif</family><prefer><family>DejaVu Sans</family></prefer></alias>
  <alias><family>system-ui</family><prefer><family>DejaVu Sans</family></prefer></alias>
</fontconfig>
EOF
find /tmp/libs/usr/share/fonts -name "*.ttf" | head -3

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/fc/fonts.conf; cd /tmp/pw && sed -i 's/height: 900/height: 1300/' check.mjs && timeout 110 node check.mjs 2>&1 | head -20

for pid in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $pid/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *"vite --port 5287"*|*"vite/bin/vite.js --port 5287"*) case "$c" in *bash*) ;; *) kill $(basename $pid) 2>/dev/null && echo "stopped $(basename $pid)";; esac;; esac; done
npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests|passed|failed"; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|built in"; rm -rf dist; git status --short
